judged_text: Webhook find-then-update/create race can create duplicate credentials for the same userId+appId under concurrent deliveries

record.issue_text: Webhook find-then-update/create race can create duplicate credentials for the same userId+appId under concurrent deliveries

adjudication.rationale: In the new webhook handler `apps/web/pages/api/webhook/app-credential.ts`, credential persistence is implemented as `findFirst({ where: { userId, appId } })` followed by either `update` or `create`. This check-then-act sequence is not atomic, so concurrent webhook deliveries for the same `userId`+`appSlug` can both observe no existing credential and both run `prisma.credential.create(...)`, potentially creating duplicates (or at minimum causing a unique-constraint error if such a constraint exists, which is not handled here).
